checks.name: staff identity required: shared admin credential alone is refused
an offer cannot publish for an UNVERIFIED supplier
policy starts OFF with no pre-approved amount (or was left off by an earlier run)
LIVE rewards cannot be switched on through the API
verified supplier + owner -> offer created and published
guest has a Marau trip (arrival + return) and sees the offer beside it
PUBLIC referral link is separate from the PRIVATE trip token and reveals nothing
public landing page and QR are served anonymously and carry no private data
referral guest view requires the private token
friend joins through the link and is attributed (response says only "applied")
self-referral (referrer's own phone) is NOT attributed
request saved; a repeated request returns the SAME request
human confirmation records the operator from the STAFF TOKEN (spoofed body field ignored)
a repeat confirm by another staff member changes nothing
SAVED request earned nothing; confirmation makes the credit only PENDING
FULFILLED BUT UNPAID does not earn credit (pay-later policy)
payment evidence recorded by a named staff member; a repeat is a no-op reporting the original operator
a refund beyond what was paid is refused
fulfilled AND paid earns exactly one credit, funding source recorded
CONCURRENT redemption: exactly one of two simultaneous applications wins
exactly ONE credit adjustment exists
guest sees original fare, credit and amount due SEPARATELY (100 / 10 / 90)
original quote is unchanged in the database
SOLD OUT under concurrency: capacity 1, two simultaneous requests -> exactly one place held
the loser is told SOLD_OUT
EXPIRED offer: refused (410) and not listed
WITHDRAWAL declines open requests but flags (never silently cancels) confirmed guests
guest CANCELLATION before the deadline releases the place
...and the released place can be taken by someone else
reversing the purchase AFTER a credit was applied flags it for a human; the fare is not silently changed
MISSING WHATSAPP: guest can still request; staff see an email fallback and a missing-owner flag
a NAMED staff owner can be assigned; a made-up name is refused
promotional needs consent (unknown -> not allowed); essential trip messages always allowed; nothing sent
PRIVATE data is private: another guest cannot touch a request; enquiry text has the reference, no contact, no wa.me link
public surfaces contain no guest email/phone/cost/owner
browse-anytime: anonymous browsing lists every published offer
a second friend's paid purchase earns a second credit (still within the synthetic cap)
SECOND credit applies to the SAME return booking: original 100, credits 20, amount due 80, two separate adjustments
FOLLOW-UP QUEUE: unassigned items are explicit, and move under their named owner once assigned
NO-WHATSAPP: essential message on WhatsApp is refused (whatsapp_unavailable) with EMAIL suggested; deliverability labelled unverified; nothing sent
a recorded delivery failure blocks that channel even for an essential message
report labels quoted value as NOT revenue and separates shares/attributions/credits/funding/payment evidence
report snapshot (all hosted synthetic data accumulated in the preview DB)
